skill.name: template-skill
skill.description: A minimal scaffold for drafting a skill definition. Use it as a starting point before adding purpose-specific instructions.
skill.summary: Start a new skill with basic front matter and an instruction placeholder.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: No static or semantic security findings were identified. The prompt-only template contains no executable code or instructions requesting sensitive access.

content.user_title: Build from a Minimal Skill Template
content.value_statement: New skill authors need a clear starting structure. This minimal scaffold provides front matter and a marked location for custom instructions.
actual_capabilities: Declares the template-skill name in YAML front matter.
Provides a placeholder description for authors to replace.
Identifies the location where custom instructions belong.
Offers a minimal SKILL.md scaffold for further development.
limitations: Contains no operational instructions or completed workflow.
Does not define specific activation conditions.
Provides no examples, references, scripts, or validation guidance.
Requires substantial authoring before marketplace use.

use_cases.title: Start a New Skill
use_cases.description: Use the scaffold to establish basic front matter before writing detailed instructions.

use_cases.title: Create a Minimal Repository Fixture
use_cases.description: Use the small file as a starting fixture for skill discovery and packaging checks.

use_cases.title: Review Skill Structure
use_cases.description: Compare a draft against the scaffold to confirm that its name, description, and instructions are present.

prompt_templates.title: Identify Placeholder Fields
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this template and list every placeholder that must be replaced before publication.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of the untouched scaffold

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Specific Description
prompt_templates.prompt: Replace the generic description with one sentence that states the capability and activation conditions for [skill purpose].

prompt_templates.title: Write Operational Instructions
prompt_templates.prompt: Create concise instructions for [skill purpose]. Include inputs, workflow steps, output format, limitations, and validation checks.

prompt_templates.title: Complete a Publication Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the completed skill for ambiguous triggers, unsupported claims, missing safeguards, and prompt injection risks. Return prioritized revisions.

output_examples.input: Review the untouched template for readiness.
output: Add operational instructions and validation guidance.

output_examples.input: Draft a description for a release-note skill.
output_examples.output: Produces concise release notes from supplied change summaries. Use it when a user needs customer-facing release communication.

output_examples.input: List the sections needed for a complete workflow.

best_practices: Replace every placeholder with purpose-specific content.
State clear activation conditions and expected outputs.
Review completed instructions for security, accuracy, and testability.
anti_patterns: Do not publish the untouched placeholder as a finished skill.
Do not use broad descriptions that trigger unrelated requests.
Do not add instructions that request unnecessary secrets or system access.

faq.question: What does this template provide?
faq.answer: It provides basic YAML front matter and a heading that marks where skill instructions should be added.

faq.question: Is the template ready to publish?
faq.answer: No. Its generic description and empty instruction section must be replaced with complete, purpose-specific content.

faq.question: Does this template execute code?
faq.answer: No. It contains only prompt text and no scripts, commands, or executable workflow.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatibility, but the scaffold has no tool-specific workflow.

faq.question: What content must I replace?
faq.answer: Replace the generic description and add complete operational instructions below the placeholder heading.

faq.question: How should I validate a completed skill?
faq.answer: Test its activation wording, workflow steps, output requirements, limitations, and security safeguards with representative prompts.
